problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign packages to identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:
* Package 1: size 33 cubic feet
* Package 2: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 3: size 38 cubic feet
* Package 4: size 50 cubic feet
* Package 5: size 47 cubic feet
* Package 6: size 61 cubic feet
* Package 7: size 60 cubic feet
* Package 8: size 68 cubic feet
* Package 9: size 51 cubic feet
* Package 10: size 47 cubic feet
* Package 11: size 34 cubic feet
* Package 12: size 59 cubic feet
* Package 13: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 14: size 36 cubic feet
* Package 15: size 62 cubic feet
* Package 16: size 46 cubic feet
* Package 17: size 65 cubic feet
* Package 18: size 55 cubic feet
* Package 19: size 68 cubic feet
* Package 20: size 58 cubic feet
* Package 21: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 22: size 40 cubic feet
* Package 23: size 68 cubic feet
* Package 24: size 56 cubic feet
* Package 25: size 38 cubic feet

Each truck has a maximum cargo capacity of 100 cubic feet. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total volume of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
